3773.title: Host artifact generation depends on npm in PATH
3773.rootCauseOneLine: The host-artifact default runner launches bare npm instead of the bundled CLI, so a restricted PATH causes ENOENT.
3773.proposedFix: Resolve the shipped npm CLI and invoke it with the application Node runtime; verify Electron and source layouts.
3773.caveats: Service-level reproduction in two clean checkouts; installed Electron, HTTP, Connect, and full Modal provisioning were not exercised. Automatic PR excluded by the packaging-change restriction.
